TechStack.title: Tech Stack
TechStack.note: Rather than listing names, each entry says where I actually used it.

desc.react: Built the screens and components of CapTeam and JICHINI
desc.reactRouter: Page routing, separate admin and student routes, protected routes
desc.javascript: ES6+ syntax and asynchronous handling with Promises and async/await for API request and response flows
desc.zustand: Global state such as the signed-in user and tokens in CapTeam
desc.axios: REST API requests with JWT and the shared request flow
desc.cssModules: Scoped styles per component, fixing global class collisions
desc.e2e: Checked permissions, error flows, responsive layout, repeated API calls and React warnings
desc.codex: Code drafts, UI edits, API tracing, warning analysis, E2E scenario checks

capteam.summary: A service that connects student survey data to AI team recommendations, lets admins review, adjust, and approve the results, and carries them through to team operations.

jichini.summary: A service that analyzes users' concerns through an AI chatbot and matches people with similar concerns in 1:1 chats.
